en.title: Keep Play running when an optional text is blank
en.body: A named noninteractive text part with an empty or whitespace-only accessible name is omitted from the semantic tree until it has words again, without changing layout or dropping an explicit label. Other semantic roles retain their existing validation.

zh.title: 可选文字为空时保持 Play 正常运行
zh.body: 命名的非交互文字若有效无障碍名称为空或仅含空白，则暂时不发布该语义节点；文字恢复后重新出现。布局及显式非空名称保持不变，其他语义角色仍执行原有校验。
